ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives parallelogram ABCD. The left schematic shows DE dropping perpendicularly from point D to the bottom side AB, with the foot of the perpendicular being E, and E on AB; the right schematic shows DF is the height from D to side BC, with the foot of the perpendicular being F. Reasoning: Because ABCD is a parallelogram, AB = DC = 12. It is known that EB = 4, therefore AE = AB - EB = 12 - 4 = 8. Triangle ADE is a right triangle, DE = 6, so AD = sqrt(8^2 + 6^2) = sqrt(64 + 36) = 10. Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, so BC = AD = 10. Using base AB and height DE to calculate the area gives 12 * 6 = 72. Using base BC and height DF to calculate the same area gives 10 * DF. Therefore 10 * DF = 72, DF = 72 / 10 = 7.2.

method.method_draft: Use an area comparison for the parallelogram. From the diagram, E is the foot of the perpendicular from D to AB, with E lying on AB, and DF is the perpendicular height to side BC. From the text, DC=12, EB=4, and DE=6. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, AB=DC=12, so AE=AB-EB=12-4=8. In right triangle ADE, compute AD=sqrt(AE^2+DE^2)=sqrt(8^2+6^2)=10, and since opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, BC=AD=10. The area using base AB is 12*6=72. The same area using base BC is 10*DF, so DF=72/10=7.2.

method.method_draft: Set up coordinates and compute the distance from D to line BC directly. From the diagram, take AB horizontal with A=(0,0) and B=(12,0), because AB=DC=12 in the parallelogram. Since EB=4 and E lies on AB below D, E is 4 units left of B, so E=(8,0). Since DE=6 perpendicular to AB, D=(8,6). Then C is 12 units horizontally to the right of D, so C=(20,6). The desired DF is the perpendicular distance from D to the line through B=(12,0) and C=(20,6). Use the point-to-line distance formula: DF=|((D-B) x (C-B))|/|C-B|. Here D-B=(-4,6), C-B=(8,6), so the cross product magnitude is |-4*6-6*8|=72, and |C-B|=sqrt(8^2+6^2)=10. Therefore DF=72/10=7.2.

再推理：按坐标法，令 AB 水平，取 A=(0,0)，B=(12,0)，因为平行四边形对边相等，所以 AB=DC=12。E 在 AB 上且 EB=4，所以 E 比 B 向左 4 个单位，E=(8,0)。DE 垂直 AB 且 DE=6，所以 D=(8,6)。DC 水平向右长 12，因此 C=(20,6)。现在 DF 是点 D 到直线 BC 的距离。用点到直线距离公式：DF=|((D-B)×(C-B))|/|C-B|。其中 D-B=(8-12,6-0)=(-4,6)，C-B=(20-12,6-0)=(8,6)。二维叉积大小为 |(-4)(6)-6(8)|=|-24-48|=72。线段 BC 的长度为 sqrt(8^2+6^2)=sqrt(100)=10。因此 DF=72/10=7.2。
